Title: The HK HUB 🇭🇰 on Instagram: "🌀 Tropical Cyclone Yagi to Hit Hong Kong This Weekend ☔

🎙️ “The Hong Kong Observatory says that it expects Tropical Cyclone Yagi to approach within 800km of the city on Tuesday and intensify into a Severe Typhoon over the weekend, when it will be closest to the territory.

Authorities from the meteorological body said that they will consider issuing Standby Signal, No. 1, or T1, between Tuesday afternoon and night, when Yagi is likely to become a Severe Tropical Storm.”
